controls.control: next float above the legal interval

limitations: Sampling a model of the specification is not a proof of every permitted result.
Only binary32 and binary64 intermediate rounding are modelled.
QEMU returned the same bits for both policies on every recorded case, so no second implementation's value is exercised.
The independent sampler shares the mathematical model; it is an implementation check, not a second hardware implementation.

model.chunking: fixed by vl and VLMAX; the scalar accumulator carries across chunks
model.conservative: seed added once at the root
model.name: rve-1.0-unordered-sum
